wins: Captured initial network topology and service inventory through automated host discovery, producing consistent evidence_ref run_20260218_093846_4cb1e3_ep001_step03.
fails: Exploit attempts failed due to missing valid credentials for service accounts, blocking lateral movement (run_20260218_093846_4cb1e3_ep001_step12).
Posture verification scripts timed out against hardened SSH (run_20260218_093846_4cb1e3_ep001_step08).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance completed but inability to escalate or maintain foothold prevented success; focus next on credential acquisition and stable access.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force and default credential guessing for identified services repeatedly exhausted rate limits and triggered defensive blocks.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner reveals service version
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap ssh2-enum-algos and ssh-hostkey scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When open SMB shares are detected on 445
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate share permissions with smbclient and map paths for credential harvesting

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows host responds but no credentials yet
skill_cards.then_action: Launch responder/kerberoast workflow to capture hashes from SMB/LDAP

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Repeated SAMR/SMB enumeration attempts laid groundwork for future credential capture
